name: Outreach
tagline: Agentic AI platform for sales and revenue teams.
description: Outreach is a sales execution platform that automates prospecting sequences, deal management, forecasting, and rep coaching across email, phone, and LinkedIn. Its agentic layer — Outreach Omni, Agent Studio, and task-specific agents — drafts outreach, preps meetings, and flags at-risk deals. Built for mid-market and enterprise B2B teams.
insight: Closed a $200M Series G in 2021 at a $4.4B valuation as the sales-engagement category leader.
edge: The deepest sequence-and-workflow engine in sales engagement, now wrapped in agents that execute prospecting and deal tasks end to end.
pros: Mature, deep sequencing and workflow engine
Agentic features for prospecting and prep

references.title: Outreach lands $200 million, pushing valuation to $4.4 billion
